page.overview:
What is Kado Kado no Mi?

One Piece Card-kun is a promotional character created for One Piece Card Game Festa 2024 2nd Anniversary, and the personification of the card game itself.

Card-kun is a slim individual with a One Piece card for a head. He wears a black tuxedo jacket, a blue vest with black buttons, blue pants, and a white collared shirt. He also wears a blue tie, white socks, blue shoes with black soles, white gloves with an ‘X’ mark on them, and a blue card box on his hip.

Little is known about Card-kun’s personality, but he uses the catchphrase .

One Piece Card-kun is unable to speak, and communicates only through hand gestures. Despite this, he still has a catchphrase.
